title: Share link creation does not enforce document-level authorization
summary:
Note: This report was drafted with AI assistance and manually verified by me.

---

## Summary
A Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA) vulnerability exists in `paperless-ngx`. An authenticated user with the `add_sharelink` permission can generate a public share link for any document in the system, even those they do not have permission to view.

## Impact
* **Confidentiality Breach:** Sensitive documents can be exposed to the public internet without authorization.
* **Data Exfiltration:** Low-privileged accounts can bypass internal permission structures to download files they are restricted from viewing.
